jobs.description: Join a new team and make a huge difference for Amazon, our sellers, and our supply chain. We are the team that deals with the exceptions to the exceptions in a complex process, saving Amazon and our sellers many millions of dollars. The FBA Defects Prevention team within Fulfillment By Amazon is responsible for identifying and preventing defects in the FBA Supply Chain. We work across sellers, fulfilment technology, robotics and carriers to detect, root cause, gather evidence and ultimately prevent issues in the supply chain. As you can imagine, Amazon's inbound supply chain are incredibly complex and highly scaled. While most people marvel at the efficiency with which the inbound processes handle most shipments, we are the team that deals with the exception - when things go wrong, we're the ones engaged to root cause and identify the problems. Detecting that these things have happened are hard - the signals coming from the network are often contradictory and misleading. The Defect Prevention space is complex, highly scaled, and ripe for use of new technologies. We can use Gen AI to analyze patterns, assess root causes, evaluate image data, and ultimately craft the right message to communicate with sellers on what has gone wrong.
